defs.def: the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow 春天；春季

ex.s: More new chat benches have sprung up across the UK and beyond.
ex.t: 更多新的聊天长椅已在英国及更远的地方涌现。

ex.s: Then I noticed folk conducting spring cleans dropping boxes of voluminous books on various subjects there.
ex.t: 后来我注意到人们在春季大扫除时往那里放了很多装满各种书籍的大箱子。

ex.s: In spring, the snow was replaced by mud over ice.
ex.t: 在Wickenden的书中，她详细描述了西部的历史，也谈到了女权主义，这当然影响了女孩们去Elkhead的决定。

ex.s: I've traveled back several times since, most recently this past spring.
ex.t: 从那以后我又回去过几次，最近一次是在今年春天。

ex.s: My imaginary Grandma's Box worked like magic that spring, and later.
ex.t: 我想象中的奶奶箱子在那个春天像魔法一样奏效，后来也是如此。

ex.s: There are three books I reread annually The first, which I take to reading every spring is Emest Hemningway’s A Moveable Feast.
ex.t: 有三本书我每年重读。第一本是海明威的《流动的盛宴》，我每年春天都会读。

ex.s: They represent the promise of spring and a renewal of life.
ex.t: 它们代表着春天的承诺与生命的更新。

ex.s: It was a tradition for the school's old team to play against the（4）     team at the end of spring practice． The old team had no coach， and they didn't even practice to（5）     the game． Being the coach of the new team， I was excited because I knew we were going to win， but to my disappointment we were defeated． I couldn't （6）     I had got into such a situation． Thinking hard about it， I came to（7）     that my team might not be the number one team in Georgia， but they were（8）     me． I had to change my （9）     about their ability and potential．
ex.t: 学校的元老队在春季训练结束时与（4）______队比赛是一个传统。元老队没有教练，他们甚至不为（5）______比赛而练习。作为新队的教练，我很兴奋，因为我知道我们会赢，但令我失望的是我们被打败了。我无法（6）______相信我会陷入这样的境地。仔细思考后，我（7）______意识到我的队可能不是佐治亚州第一名，但他们信任（8）______我。我必须改变我对他们能力和潜力的（9）______看法。

ex.s: He directed the wasted water into shallow basins where it froze, and was stored until the spring.
ex.t: 他将这些浪费的水引入浅水池中冻结储存，直到春天使用。

ex.s: Last spring in Yellowstone, I followed a path that took me through a dark forest.
ex.t: 去年春天在黄石公园，我沿着一条穿过黑暗森林的小路前行。

ex.s: Understanding ideas (two pictures) (picture 1) Zhuang people (picture 2) Yao people Longji Rice Terraces 1 Imagine mountains wrapped in silver water, shining in the spring sun.
ex.t: 理解思路：想象群山被银色的水包裹，在春天的阳光下闪闪发光。

ex.s: We could also say Imagine that in spring the mountains are covered bv strips of water, which shine brightly in the sun.
ex.t: 我们也可以说，想象春天里群山被条带状的水田覆盖，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

ex.s: Six months after suffering our （14）     on the spring practice field， we won our first game and our second， and continued to （15）     ．Finally， we faced the number one team in the state． I felt that it would be a （16）     for us even if we lost the game． But that wasn't what happened． My boys beat the best team in Georgia， giving me one of the greatest （17）     of my life！
ex.t: 在春季训练场遭受（14）___六个月后，我们赢下第一场、第二场，并继续（15）___。终于，我们面对全州第一的队。我觉得即使输了，对我们也是（16）___。但事实并非如此。我的孩子们击败了佐治亚最好的队，给了我一生中最伟大的（17）___之一！

defs.def: a twisted piece of metal that can be pushed, pressed or pulled but which always returns to its original shape or position afterwards 弹簧；发条

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 想到讲故事，你脑海中浮现的第一件事，或许是爸妈用各自的嗓音为你讲王子、城堡和怪兽的故事时，你心中形成的幻想世界。

defs.def: the ability of a spring to return to its original position 弹性；弹力

ex.s: This hit home for me as I was sitting with my 2-year-old grandson on a sofa over the Spring Festival holiday.
ex.t: 今年春节假期，当我抱着两岁的孙子坐在沙发上时，这一点让我深有感触。

ex.s: You'd better not have your hair cut during the Spring Festival month.
ex.t: 春节期间最好不要剪头发。

ex.s: Now was the spring of the water pistol.
ex.t: 我想出了一个对付禁品的方法。

defs.def: a place where water comes naturally to the surface from under the ground 泉

ex.s: They were almost knee﹣deep when they realized it was a hot spring.
ex.t: 当他们意识到那是温泉时，水已几乎没到膝盖。

ex.s: The park sits on a supervolcano, and visitors can see colourful hot springs, bubbling pots of mud and geysers.
ex.t: 这个公园坐落在一座超级火山上，游客可以看到五颜六色的温泉、冒泡的泥潭和间歇泉。

ex.s: 2646 University Blvd W, Silver Spring, MD 20902
ex.t: 2646 大学大道西，银泉，马里兰州 20902

ex.s: The hot spring at the foot of the mountain is something you must try after the climb.
ex.t: 山脚下的温泉是你爬完山一定要试的。

defs.def: a cheerful, lively quality 活力；朝气
a quick sudden jump upwards or forwards 跳；跃

ex.s: For some moments, John said nothing, but, suddenly, he sprang to his feet and cried, “I have a great idea!
ex.t: 约翰沉默了片刻，但忽然一跃而起，喊道：“我有个好主意！”

ex.s: For some moments, John said nothing, but, suddenly, he sprang to his feet and cried, “I have a great idea!
ex.t: 约翰沉默了片刻，但忽然一跃而起，喊道：“我有个好主意！”

defs.def: to move suddenly and with one quick movement in a particular direction 人或动物
to move suddenly and violently 物体
to do sth, ask sth or say sth that sb is not expecting 突如其来地做；冷不防地问；突然说
to appear or come somewhere suddenly 突然出现（或来到）
to help a prisoner to escape 帮助 … 逃跑（或越狱）；营救
to make a trap for catching animals close suddenly 使捕兽器突然合上
to try to trick sb into doing or saying sth; to succeed in this 设套诱使某人做（或说）
